scope: Standalone Club Machine: roundtrip reading playback, gold navigation cues, relocated Grid and visual Now Playing status
roundtrip: From the current Family/reading-position coordinate, visits all 21 unique coordinates and returns to that starting coordinate. Stops after return arrival. This checks reading coordinates only, not scientific state identity.
grid: Original guide-hold button moved into player with callback intact. Grid-off now hides persistent scaffold immediately; transient preview on layout change retained. No new address mapping.
during_playback: Basic form, A/B/overview and LJ controls do not pause the player. Display camera/layout flights preserve pending elevator travel. Direct coordinate selection or canvas interaction interrupts playback.
visual_feedback: Gold identifies reading head, active coordinate and navigation controls; display selections use cyan and triangle emphasis uses violet. Existing typed relation colors unchanged. Local Now Playing overlay shows current coordinate, view and light mode.
